Numerical deviations of the model from the measurements of Ag-110m
Register rows of Ag-110m (including rows labelled with the element only): 175; 119 digitised from published figures (labelled digitised, with their reading uncertainty), 56 tabulated or
printed and exact as printed.
Comparison status of these rows: DATA INCOMPLETE 10; NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE 165.
NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE because the measured quantity is not the model quantity: 29 x deposition_cup_history (deposition-cup collection); 52 x failed_or_released_particles (failed SiC or
releasing particle); 1 x fuel_sphere (fuel sphere of a benchmark); 32 x includes_in_pile_inventory (total includes in-pile inventory); 22 x irradiation_phase_quantity (irradiation-phase
inventory location); 16 x loose_particles_with_failures (loose particles including failed ones); 2 x mixed_particles (mixture of failed and intact particles); 11 x other_fuel_batch (AGR-2
fuel).
E-033 | 1600 °C | 300 h at temperature | measured 1.800e-3 (digitised) | model 5.919e-1 | signed log10 ratio 2.517e0 for scale only: the denominator is not established (decision 22), so no
absolute or relative deviation is formed

E-036 | 1600 °C | 400 h at temperature | measured 1.500e-4 (digitised) | model 7.033e-1 | signed log10 ratio 3.671e0 for scale only: the denominator is not established (decision 22), so no

E-037 | 1700 °C | 303 h at temperature | measured 2.800e-3 (digitised) | model 7.757e-1 | signed log10 ratio 2.443e0 for scale only: the denominator is not established (decision 22), so no
absolute or relative deviation is formed
No Ag-110m row supports a point comparison, so the absolute deviation, the relative deviation in percent and the log-space root-mean-square deviation are not defined for Ag-110m (the log10
ratios above are for scale only and enter no aggregate); no number is substituted.

Experimental values: Collin et al. (2016); IAEA (1997); IAEA (2012); Morris et al. (2016); Stempien et al. (2023). A bar on a digitised point is the reading uncertainty of the register (the error of reading the

point off the published figure); it is not a measurement uncertainty, and the sources report none for these rows, so no other error bar is drawn. Compact values are not single-particle values; rows without a time at

temperature or at a temperature outside 1600 to 1800 °C are not drawn. Analytical-series values are drawn only where the criterion holds: a value of the independent analytical series is exported only where (1) the

time is not earlier than the series' own minimum valid time (omitted modes below exp(-40) of their weight) and (2) the value exceeds the series' estimated absolute accuracy (about 2.2e-16 over the smallest flux

ratio of the shooting solution), and is positive; otherwise it is left empty. Model: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit df8b0b4851d05789a537a40a9ff33510f9ac866a;

registered AGR1-B-M16 geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients chosen by the strato-data selection function (register sets C16-T2 and C16-BUF), evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only start;
constant temperature; decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a numerical comparison, not an experimental validation.
